analysis.method: Local Whisper transcript plus Codex inspection of sequential recording frames; AI-authored Spanish adaptation. These six cards are a selected batch, not whole-match analysis.
limitations: Player names use the commentary, not automated face recognition.
Raw ASR misrecognizes names and describes a left-footed volley as left-handed; lesson wording avoids that error.
The initial crowd-only language detection said Latin; that output was rejected and the English commentary was transcribed with language=en.
Live action and subsequent replays/commentary are distinguished. Recording timestamps differ from the displayed match clock.
Illustrations are generated teaching aids, not evidence or exact reconstructions.

cards.title: Down the left
cards.hint: Por la izquierda tells you which side.

evidence.commentarySummary: The commentator identifies a run by Gareth Bale with Piqué chasing back.
evidence.visualObservation: An attacker in white advances down the near left flank with a blue-and-red defender chasing; the camera follows his run.

cards.title: Into the area
cards.hint: Centra means sends a cross into the penalty area.

evidence.commentarySummary: The commentator describes Bale crossing to Benzema inside the box.
evidence.visualObservation: The wide view follows the ball from the left flank toward the white attacker in the penalty area.

cards.title: A chance goes high
cards.hint: De volea describes hitting the ball before it bounces.

evidence.commentarySummary: The commentator identifies a Benzema volley and then says it goes high over the crossbar.
evidence.visualObservation: The white attacker finishes the move toward goal; the broadcast cuts to Benzema and then Bale. The score remains 0–0. The high miss is described by commentary.

cards.title: Behind the defence
cards.hint: Al espacio means into open space.

evidence.commentarySummary: The commentator names Jordi Alba and describes him getting behind the defence.
evidence.visualObservation: A blue-and-red runner receives the forward ball down the left and advances into the penalty area, beyond the retreating white defenders.

cards.title: The pass back
cards.spanish: Alba pasa el balón hacia atrás.
cards.hint: Hacia atrás means backwards; here the pass goes back toward a teammate.

evidence.commentarySummary: The live call connects Alba with Coutinho; the following analysis explicitly describes Alba passing back to him.
evidence.visualObservation: From near the left byline, the blue-and-red player sends the ball diagonally back into the area toward the arriving teammate.

cards.title: The opening goal
cards.hint: Marca un gol means scores a goal. Primero becomes primer before gol.

evidence.commentarySummary: The commentator announces a Barcelona goal and identifies Coutinho as the scorer.
evidence.visualObservation: The arriving blue-and-red attacker finishes from inside the box; the keeper drops across goal as the ball reaches the goal, followed by the scorer turning away.

stories.title: A chance over the bar
sceneSpanish: Bale avanza por la izquierda. Un defensor lo persigue. Madrid tiene una oportunidad.
Bale centra el balón al área. Benzema está dentro del área.
Benzema remata de volea. El disparo sale alto. El marcador sigue 0–0.
sceneEnglish: Bale advances down the left. A defender chases him. Madrid have a chance.
Bale crosses the ball into the penalty area. Benzema is inside the area.
Benzema volleys the ball. The shot goes high. The score stays 0–0.
stories.recognitionExplanation: Benzema shoots over the crossbar. This chance does not change the score.
stories.recallHint: The ball. Remember the accent on ó.
stories.useHelp: Do you prefer to pass or shoot? Write your own preference in Spanish.
stories.transfer: Beyond sport: Prefiero esperar. — I prefer to wait.

stories.title: The run, the pass, the goal
sceneSpanish: Jordi Alba corre al espacio. Recibe el balón por la izquierda y entra en el área.
Alba pasa el balón hacia atrás. Coutinho llega al área para recibir el pase.
Coutinho dispara y marca el primer gol. Barcelona se pone por delante.
sceneEnglish: Jordi Alba runs into space. He receives the ball on the left and enters the penalty area.
Alba passes the ball back. Coutinho arrives in the area to receive the pass.
Coutinho shoots and scores the opening goal. Barcelona take the lead.
stories.recognitionExplanation: Alba runs down the left and passes back to Coutinho, who finishes the move.
stories.recallHint: Backwards. It starts with a and has an accent on á.
stories.usePrompt: ¿Qué parte de la jugada te gusta?
stories.useHelp: Which part of the move do you like? Write a short answer in Spanish.
stories.modelAnswer: Me gusta el pase de Alba.
stories.transfer: Beyond sport: Me gusta esta idea. — I like this idea.
